comparison: same implementation commit; only design documentation varies

tasks.request: Add a notifications preference group to the isolated design-system preview. Reuse SettingsSection, SettingsGroupCard, SettingsRow and Switch. The preference is a controlled local fixture, initially enabled. Provide English and Simplified Chinese labels, pending and failure views, and a narrow layout. Do not add persistence or service calls.
acceptance: Uses existing settings composition and real Switch semantics
Visible label and accessible name match language
Pending disables duplicate action; failure preserves confirmed value
Narrow layout preserves full label and reachable control
No local hardcoded colors/font sizes or experimental import bypass

tasks.request: Add an isolated preview for approving a command with a long command, working directory and reason. Reuse DecisionCard and the existing approval action components. Include pending, failed and unknown outcomes. The only actions update a local fixture; do not execute commands.
acceptance: Summary is bounded and full original command remains reachable
Actions are reachable with keyboard and have accessible names
Unknown outcome offers inspection, never automatic replay
Uses semantic tokens and existing shared components
Fixture explicitly does not establish real permission execution

tasks.request: Change the isolated plugin-resource list preview to show distinct loading, confirmed empty, search-no-match and failed-refresh states. Reuse existing feedback and empty-state components. Preserve previously confirmed rows when refresh fails and add a working clear-search fixture action.
acceptance: Loading and unknown completeness never claim an empty list
Search-no-match clear action retains list identity
English and Simplified Chinese text and accessible action name
No new list framework, execution owner or style literals

resultPolicy: Retain every trial, including failure and timeout. Report unavailable measurements as unavailable. No trial counts as complete without a diff, read manifest, check logs, and review.
